newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mostly up in PM, but active Aug eases.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mostly up in PM, but active Aug eases.

text.p: Most positions in LIFFE sugar were higher in afternoon trade, but the market lacked real direction in the absence of a lead from New York, traders said.

The exception to the rise was front month August, which by 1512 GMT was 10 cents lower at $321.10. August dominated the day's activity with 1,995 lots of a total 3,492 so far. AA trades and switches played a big role, one trader said.
October was $1.0 higher at $315.70 on 775 lots.
But the absence of strong activity in New York left the market rangebound and subdued, the trader said.
